name: fillet_rounds_the_four_corners
why: ENTRY Z-C6, the second half. `fillet_edges` was in the catalogue with a single case in the REGRESSION (r04), which runs only with `-Regression`: in a normal run no case touched it. The new contract check found it, the first run in which the bench wrote its own green cases (25/9/2026).
defect_caught: A fillet that is born on fewer edges than requested, or with the wrong radius: the volume tells them apart to the thousandth, because the hand calculation is exact.
_the_edges_by_where_they_are: The four vertical edges (along Y) of the plate, named by coordinates: x = ±50, z = ±30. Measured with the bench probe on 25/9/2026.

expect.why: the four corners, not one fewer

expect.tolerance_why: 120000 minus 4 x (1 - pi/4) x 5^2 x 20 = 429.204: the calculation has pi inside, and the hundredth is rounding. Only three corners would give 119678.097, a radius of 4 would give 119725.318
